title: SanaCkoala
description:
[b]SanaCkoala[/b] adds two new playable characters to Slay the Spire 2, the Koala and the Panda. Both work in singleplayer, and they are built to play well together in co-op.

[h2]The Koala[/h2]
70 HP. Starter relic: [b]Eucalyptus Leaf[/b] (start each combat with 3 Drowsy). Touch of Orobas upgrades it to [b]Eucalyptus Crown[/b] (6 Drowsy).
[list]
[*][b]Drowsy[/b]: at the end of your turn, gain Block equal to your Drowsy.
[*][b]Waking up[/b]: some cards remove all of your Drowsy at once for a big effect.
[*]Three ways to play: build a Hibernation Fortress that stays Drowsy; bank Drowsy for an Alarm Burst; or manage a hand of Dream and Retain cards.
[/list]

[h2]The Panda[/h2]
80 HP. Starter relic: [b]Bamboo Basket[/b] (start each combat with 3 Bamboo). Touch of Orobas upgrades it to [b]Bamboo Hamper[/b] (6 Bamboo).
[list]
[*][b]Bamboo[/b] is a resource you gather with cards and powers.
[*][b]Munch N[/b]: if you have at least N Bamboo, the card spends it and triggers a bonus effect.
[*][b]Full[/b]: your first Munch each turn gives one Full, which feeds the menu, belly and Roll cards.
[*]Four ways to play: Full menu choices, Block and counterattacks, multi-hit Strength turns, or building and spending Roll momentum.
[/list]

Each character has 87 cards (3 Basic, 20 Common, 36 Uncommon, 26 Rare and 2 Ancient), the same split as the vanilla characters. Each also has seven relics on top of the starter relic, and three potions.

[h2]Ancient cards and events[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Archaic Tooth[/b] turns Doze into Deep Sleep and Gather Bamboo into Bamboo Harvest.
[*][b]Dusty Tome[/b] gives the Koala Lazy Sunday and the Panda Rolling Thunder.
[*]Twelve events appear only in runs with the Koala or the Panda, such as The Last Dumpling, Eucalyptus Tollbooth, Dream Exchange and The Summit Picnic.
[*]Two enchantments come from these events: [b]Well-Rested[/b] (a Retained card gives Block) and [b]Freshly-Cut[/b] (a Panda card that Munches gives a short damage boost).
[/list]

[h2]Co-op content[/h2]
In multiplayer runs, both characters start with [b]Hold Hands[/b], and five more colorless cards can appear: [b]Share a Bite[/b], [b]Quarrel[/b], [b]Make Up[/b], [b]Assist[/b] and [b]Promise[/b]. The Koala has five co-op cards of its own and the Panda has seven, such as [b]Wake-Up Kiss[/b], [b]Pajama Party[/b], [b]Piggyback Charge[/b] and [b]Partner in Crime[/b]. Each character also has a co-op relic, three shared relics can drop, and several events need a second player. Co-op cards that give resources target one ally you choose. None of this shows up in singleplayer.

[h2]Installation[/h2]
[list]
[*]Requires [b]BaseLib[/b]. Steam asks you to subscribe to it as well.
[*]Subscribe and start the game. The first time, the game asks whether to load mods; allow it.
[*]For multiplayer, every player needs this mod on the same version.
[*]Do not also keep a manual copy in the game's [i]mods[/i] folder.
[*]Modded play uses a separate set of save files. Your unmodded saves are not touched. On a fresh modded save, the mod still starts act 1 with Neow.
[/list]

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
Tested on game version v0.107.1 only. Other versions may not load.

Source code and full README: [url=https://github.com/PingChunChung/spire-duo]GitHub[/url]

Fan-made mod, not affiliated with or endorsed by Mega Crit. Card art, icons and character images made with AI image generation.
changeNote:
[b]v0.4.0[/b]
[list]
[*]Both characters were reworked so each playstyle feels different. The Koala has 12 new cards and the Panda 18, replacing cards that played too much alike.
[*]Koala lines: Hibernation Fortress (Sleep Debt, Night Watch, Fortress Nap), Alarm Burst (Alarm Drill, Snooze Again, Rude Alarm) and Dream / Retain (Dream Journal, Dream Gate, Deep Script). New Dream card: 0 cost, Ethereal, choose 6 damage or 6 Block.
[*]Panda lines: Full menu (Taste Test, Packed Lunch, Second Course), belly counter (Soft Landing, Counter Curl, Belly Fortress), multi-hit Strength (Paw Practice, Protein Shake, Maul Rhythm) and the new Roll momentum (Roll Start, Downhill, Pinball Panda).
[*]Drowsy and Bamboo are harder to stack for free: Doze, Power Nap, Warm Milk, Bamboo Juice and several Munch powers were toned down, and Munch bonuses from Iron Hide, Big Appetite and Dig In trigger once per turn.
[*]New relics: Sleepy Ledger, Dream Catcher's Bell, Bamboo Sled, Split Bamboo, and the shared Passing Note. Each character now has three potions (new: Lucid Tea, Crunchy Shoot) and there is an event potion, Half-and-Half.
[*]Co-op cards and relics that give resources now target one chosen ally, so they no longer scale with the number of players (Hold Hands, Pajama Party, Pillow Toss, Nap Together, Shared Blanket, Picnic Mat, Spare Key).
[*]Eight new events: The Last Dumpling, Borrowed Hammock, Eucalyptus Tollbooth, Honeyed Hive, Bamboo Appraiser, Rainy-Day Argument, Dream Exchange and The Summit Picnic, each with its own illustration.
[*]Two new enchantments from events: Well-Rested and Freshly-Cut.
[*]Picnic for Two is now a shared vote, so four players no longer each heal 40 HP.
[*]Cranky Swat now wakes you first and applies 2 Vulnerable if any Drowsy was removed, then deals 8 damage.
[*]A defeated Koala or Panda now tips over and turns grey, and stands back up when revived after a won fight.
[*]New card art for every new card, and new icons for the new powers, relics and potions.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]At rest sites, Mend can now target the Koala and the Panda by hovering the character.
[/list]
Every player needs to update before playing together.
Source and details: [url=https://github.com/PingChunChung/spire-duo]GitHub[/url]

[b]v0.4.0[/b]
[list]
[*]兩個角色重新設計，讓每種玩法玩起來都不一樣。無尾熊換掉 12 張、熊貓換掉 18 張玩起來太像的卡。
[*]無尾熊玩法：冬眠堡壘（睡眠債、夜間守望、堡壘午睡）、鬧鐘爆發（鬧鐘演練、再睡一次、粗魯鬧鐘）、夢境與保留（夢境日誌、夢境之門、深層劇本）。新增「夢」：0 費、虛無，從 6 點傷害或 6 點格擋擇一。
[*]熊貓玩法：吃飽菜單（試吃、便當、第二道菜）、肚皮反擊（軟著陸、反擊蜷縮、肚皮要塞）、多段力量（熊掌練習、蛋白飲、熊掌節奏），以及新的翻滾連段（起滾、下坡、彈珠熊貓）。
[*]睡意和竹子不再能免費一直疊：打盹、小睡片刻、熱牛奶、竹子汁和幾個啃竹子的能力都調低了，鐵布衫、大胃王、開動了的啃竹子額外效果每回合只觸發一次。
[*]新遺物：瞌睡帳本、捕夢鈴、竹子雪橇、剖開的竹子，以及共用遺物傳紙條。每個角色現在有三瓶藥水（新增清醒茶、脆竹筍），另有事件藥水對半喝。
[*]給資源的雙人卡和遺物改成只給一名指定隊友，不會再隨人數倍增（牽手、睡衣派對、傳枕頭、一起睡午覺、共用毛毯、野餐墊、備用鑰匙）。
[*]新增 8 個事件：最後一顆餃子、借來的吊床、尤加利收費亭、蜜糖蜂巢、竹材鑑定師、雨天爭論、夢境交換所、山頂野餐，每個都有專屬插圖。
[*]新增 2 種事件附魔：睡飽了、新鮮切口。
[*]雙人野餐改成全隊投票，四人局不會再每人各回 40 HP。
[*]起床巴掌改成先醒來，有移除睡意就施加 2 層易傷，再造成 8 點傷害。
[*]無尾熊和熊貓倒下時會往後倒並變灰，戰鬥勝利復活後會站回來。
[*]所有新卡都有卡圖，新的能力、遺物和藥水也都有圖示。
[/list]
[b]錯誤修正[/b]
[list]
[*]休息處的癒合現在可以直接指著無尾熊和熊貓選取。
[/list]
多人連線前，每位玩家都要先更新。
原始碼與詳細說明：[url=https://github.com/PingChunChung/spire-duo]GitHub[/url]
